our_interpretation: The firm, testable component is the assertion that there had been no meaningful progress in reducing hallucinations.
The surrounding retrospective discusses warnings beginning in March 2024. I use March through the post date as the comparison period; the sentence itself supplies no baseline date.

For the business-use component, I read high reliability as requiring factual output that can be relied upon without independent verification. This added interpretation materially affects the assessment.
May never go away expresses a possibility, not a forecast that hallucinations will certainly persist forever.
